description: Comprehensive production MariaDB dashboard for mysqld_exporter. Database panels use job=mariadb and therefore work with the user's current static exporter scrape. Filesystem/PVC capacity is intentionally not faked here; it requires Kubernetes/node storage metrics to be scraped by Prometheus.

options.content:
**MariaDB target:** `mariadb-exporter.fyno-vks-prod.svc.cluster.local:9104`  
This dashboard intentionally follows the user's current Prometheus scrape job `mariadb`. The exporter endpoint is shown here only because that is the user's accepted naming; all metric queries use the database exporter metrics.

### Disk monitoring
The MariaDB exporter scrape supplied for this dashboard does **not** contain filesystem/PVC capacity or free-space metrics. Therefore this dashboard does not fabricate disk values. For production disk usage, Prometheus must also scrape Kubernetes/kubelet volume metrics or node-exporter filesystem metrics. Once those are available, add PVC/filesystem panels for the MariaDB volume with capacity, used, available, and utilization %. Database-level I/O above is still shown under the InnoDB sections.

title: MariaDB Production Observability
